settlement_source: Contract terms: league governing the game (NCAA); series metadata lists ESPN and Kalshi using NCAA info. Expiration Value = Underlying as documented by Source Agency at 10:00 AM ET on Expiration Date.
settlement_variable: Combined points of both teams in the specified period (default full game incl. overtime). Over/under half-point threshold.
timezone: ET (10:00 AM ET expiration; date = originally scheduled date in ET)
tie_handling: N/A with half-point strikes; behavior at exact equality for whole-number counts unspecified = unknown
trading_close_vs_settlement: Market close_time (e.g. 2026-11-02T23:45Z) is days after game date; Last Trading Time = Expiration time per terms, but can_close_early=1 and settlement_timer 180s so markets settle shortly after outcome is determined. Latest expiration 15th day after game.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed but starts within 48h: stays open, settles on final result
Not started within 48h: resolves to fair price (Exchange sole discretion)
Suspended/abandoned <55 min play and not resuming in 48h: last fair price (Exchange discretion) except already-decided markets
55+ min played or league declares game final: settle on state at that point
Forfeit before kickoff: last fair price; after kickoff: league official result
Venue change/home-away reversal or >48h move: fair price
Kalshi may start Market Outcome Review; Rule 6.3(b) if value undeterminable
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'Full Game: Over X points' omits that overtime counts and that the 55-minute rule can end a game early at current score
Market is dated by originally scheduled ET date; rescheduled games may still count
toxicity_flags: running score observable live; in-game total repriced faster than quotes update (latency-adversarial)
outcome locked once Over line crossed while market stays open until close (stale quotes)
discretionary fair price on postponed/suspended games
notes: Terms read from FOOTBALLTOTALS.pdf. Settlement-source pages not individually fetched; feed latencies are estimates, unverified.
